change_reason: The final unchanged 480-step Route196 smoke learned dense R and on/off-path K ordering but retained the majority maintain-language answer for on-path UQ. The five source driving records have a 3:1:1 maintain/caution/prepare_to_yield class prior, so the next bounded diagnostic changes sampling rather than adding epochs to the failed objective.
objective: Teach ORION/VLM to interpret frozen task-agnostic spatial observation UQ, predict an explicit task-relevance map, and produce map-consistent QA explanations before any trajectory optimization.
frozen: ORION visual encoder and detection/map heads

sampling.method: oversample minority target stances with replacement to the majority stance count independently in each epoch

task_relevance.prediction_source: VLM-fused hidden states at UQ token positions

route196_new_objective_smoke.stop_policy: One run only. If the on-path language preference gate fails, stop and inspect UQ-to-language attention or replace the objective under a new amendment; do not extend steps.

evaluation_gates: held-out route/event dense relevance BCE and ranking
on-path UQ must increase K more than equal-strength off-path UQ
zero-UQ and irrelevant-UQ hard negatives must not produce conservative language by default
on-path UQ must prefer its target caution/prepare answer over the matched maintain counterfactual
structured QA answer must agree with dense R and K sidecars

launch_locks.unlock_stage2l_pilot: Route196 balanced-language smoke passes all unchanged semantic gates and the reviewed 8-event 6/2 pilot is frozen.

claim_boundary: Sampling repair for an engineering learnability smoke only. It provides no held-out generalization, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
